'''Chris Chaetlin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Lompoc tournament (16 December)]] on 16 December 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base / Spy madness]], according to Cat Ceder's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1551">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-17-lompoc-again-12-16-00d1551/ lompoc-again-12-16-00], DeckTech (Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder, 17 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-17-lompoc-again-12-16-00d1551/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
